changelog: Fixed frontmatter parser to handle very long description lines and multiple --- markers
Rewrote _split_frontmatter() to scan line-by-line instead of string search for robust parsing
Fixed skill discovery truncation issue that prevented 0day-find and other skills with long descriptions from loading
Enhanced install_ida.sh with symlink verification, built-in skills validation, and Python import tests
Added diagnostic output to installer showing skill count and sample skills
Fixed auto-update system version detection to use git tags instead of local update.json
Added .version marker file to track actual installed version separately from update.json
Enhanced updater with multi-source version detection (git tags, marker file, metadata fallback)
Fixed critical import syntax error in skills_tab.py preventing skills from loading in UI settings
Corrected relative import statement from 'from...skills' to 'from ...skills' (missing space)
Restored visibility of all skills in Settings dialog (0day-find, android-exploit, app-shielding-bypass, etc.)
Redesigned IDA Pro UI with dark glassmorphism aesthetics and IDA-matching color palette (#3a9fd5 accent)
Enhanced ContextBar with interactive jump-to-address/function actions, active LED status indicator, and dynamic token usage warning colors
Redesigned input area layout with top action toolbar, quick skill chips (/vuln-audit, /memory-corruption, etc.), and glow focus styling
Smart idapyswitch auto-configuration selecting system python3 matching version
Proactive site-packages path injection for embedded IDA Python interpreter to recognize system pip packages (anthropic, etc.)
Improved auto-update engine with git pull strategy support for git-managed plugin installations
Fixed white background container fill artifact on Linux and macOS UI panels
Interactive CLI shell interface with Ctrl+O raw-mode and streaming UI
Docker containerization support with multi-platform images
SSH remote execution and file transfer tools
Shell command safety checks with configurable auto-approve limits
LM Studio provider support for local LLM integration
Added container-escape, crypto-vuln, iot-vuln, scada-vuln, vm-escape, web3-vuln security skills
